lastResponse.text: Absolutely. Fastest option: I can connect you to a live two one one specialist right now and have them give you only two things first: nearest open cooling spot and the quickest bus route. No long story, minimal details. If your battery is about to die, tell them “closest bus-accessible cooling center, no paperwork if possible” first thing. If you start feeling faint, confused, or unsafe from heat, call nine one one.
